title: Purair® FUMEBOX™ - Portable Ductless Fume Adsorber for Chemical Manipulations
meta_title: Purair FUMEBOX - Portable Ductless Fume Adsorber for Chemical Manipulations
meta_description: The Purair® FUMEBOX™ is a compact, portable ductless fume adsorber designed to protect users from chemicals, vapors, or non-toxic powders during low-volume laboratory procedures.
meta_keywords: ductless fume adsorber, portable fume hood, chemical manipulation safety, laboratory fume containment
short_description: The Purair® FUMEBOX™ is designed to protect the user from chemicals, vapors or non-toxic powders during low-volume chemical manipulations by effectively containing low concentrations of noxious fumes, vapors, or powders.
full_description: The Purair® FUMEBOX™ is a compact, portable ductless fume adsorber designed to protect users from chemicals, vapors, or non-toxic powders during low-volume laboratory procedures. With a low-profile design, the FUMEBOX can be easily positioned on shallow countertops or under cabinets, providing a clear viewing enclosure to prevent chemical splash. Its modular construction allows for multiple configuration options to meet your specific needs.
seo_content: The FUMEBOX features a crossflow or upflow airflow design to effectively capture and contain noxious fumes, vapors, and powders. It is constructed with epoxy-coated steel for durability and easy cleaning. The unit meets OSHA standards for laboratory chemical exposure and is ISO 14001 and ISO 9001 certified for environmental and quality management.

Construction & Compliance.OSHA Compliance: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood.

Filtration.Filter Types: GP Plus!, ACI Plus!/SUL, ACR, ACM, AMM, FOR, HEPA/ULPA

page_content_sections.overview: The Purair® FUMEBOX™ is a compact, portable ductless fume adsorber designed to protect users from chemicals, vapors, or non-toxic powders during low-volume laboratory procedures.
page_content_sections.specifications: The FUMEBOX features epoxy-coated steel construction, meets OSHA standards, and is ISO 14001 and ISO 9001 certified. It operates on 120V, 60Hz power with a NEMA 5-15P plug.
page_content_sections.applications: The FUMEBOX is suitable for a wide range of applications including soldering, histology, cover slipping, staining, pathology, graphic arts, sign shops, art conservation, electronics assembly, particulate control, manufacturing processes, and air purification.

models_data.seo_description: The AP60H-A is a benchtop, horizontal Purair FUMEBOX model with a 21" width, 115VAC, 60Hz power, and crossflow airflow design.
The AP60V-A is a benchtop, vertical Purair FUMEBOX model with a 21" width, 115VAC, 60Hz power, and upflow airflow design.
The AP60H-XL-A is a benchtop, horizontal Purair FUMEBOX model with a 30" width, 115VAC, 60Hz power, and crossflow airflow design.
